findings.issue: _pool module-level singleton leak: after live-DB tests set _pool, the 'Route registration (no-DB)' test deletes DATABASE_URL and creates a new server, but getPool() returned the already-set _pool instead of throwing HttpError(503). Result: test got 404 instead of 503. Fails only in full suite run, passes in isolation.
findings.suggestion: Export resetPoolForTesting() from registry-defs.ts and call it before createServer() in the no-DB test. FIXED in c47837d.

findings.issue: kind:'noop' was defined in UpdateSchemaResult union and handled in response logic but updateSchemaInTx never returned it. Dead branch. Unchanged schema still triggered a DB UPDATE and returned {updated:true}.
findings.suggestion: Remove 'noop' from union and delete the dead branch, or add deep-equal guard. FIXED in c47837d — noop removed, ADR-honesty comment added.

findings.issue: AC-13 (partial failure → ROLLBACK) is listed in the file header as covered but no live test exists. Rollback correctness of the force path on appendAuditEvent failure is not verified by a live-DB probe.
findings.suggestion: Add a live-DB test that simulates appendAuditEvent throwing; verify record_schema, stale, and tier remain unchanged. DEFERRED — acceptable nit for MVP phase.

findings.issue: SET LOCAL choros.promoting='1' was issued before the soft-path early return. The GUC was harmless but unnecessary in the soft path and misled readers.
findings.suggestion: Move SET LOCAL into the force path block, after the soft-path early return. FIXED in c47837d — GUC now only on force path.

findings.issue: Per-dep and per-page UPDATE loops issue one SQL statement per affected dep/page (N+1 roundtrips). Not harmful at MVP scale but inefficient at large dep counts.
findings.suggestion: Replace loops with unnest-based batch UPDATEs. DEFERRED — acceptable nit for MVP phase.
